fusions.name: Line Thrown
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 8 damage, up to 2.4 times that at maximum range. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Reach of Iron
fusions.desc: Thrusts along a narrow cone 7 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Lance Rush
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Aimed at the Door
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 15% against targets at low health.
